Amir Nur bin Mujahid Was born in 1528 AD and become Amir Al-muaminin in 1552 AD
He is recognized by the People of harar as the leader of the 2nd Conquest and by building the defensive Wall of Jugol from 1552-1555  and minting the first harar money coin...
